raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Fixes #57699. `_qwen3_arg_converter` ended a parameter value only at `</parameter>` or the next `<parameter=`. Models sometimes close `</function>` without closing the last parameter, and then:

- non-streaming: the final conversion (`partial=False`) dropped the trailing value, so `arguments` came back without it (with several parameters, the call silently lost the last one);
- streaming: partial conversions had already streamed the value, but the flush at `TOOL_CALL_END` produced `{}`, shorter than what was already sent, so nothing more was emitted and the client kept the clipped version.

Not a duplicate: the two earlier qwen3 parser fixes I checked (#43243's JSON-first parsing, and the `null`-handling change) cover different shapes; nothing open touches this one.

The fix is to run the trailing-parameter capture in both modes instead of only in partial mode. The accumulated raw body never contains the `</function>` marker (the engine consumes it as a terminal event), so the trailing value runs cleanly to the end of the buffer. Empty trailing values behave exactly like explicitly-closed empty parameters.

## Test Plan

```
python -m pytest tests/parser/engine/test_qwen3.py -q
python -m pytest tests/parser/engine -q
ruff check / ruff format --check on the two touched files
```

Three tests pin the shape: the BFCL example from the issue (non-streaming), earlier params kept with an unclosed tail (non-streaming), and no truncation in the streamed flush.

## Test Result

Rebuilt on current main `fc0cfcdc05`:

- Red-green on that main: all three cases fail without the converter change (non-streaming returns `{}` or drops the tail; the streamed flush truncates), and pass with it. The unpatched file is 82 passed / 3 failed.
- `tests/parser/engine/test_qwen3.py`: 85 passed.
- Complete `tests/parser/engine`: 6041 passed, with no excluded tests or environment failures.
- Ruff check / Ruff format / diff check: clean.
- The previous pre-commit failure was in the untouched Step 5 sparse-attention file. Current main includes #62593's fix for that base failure; this PR adds no unrelated mypy change.
- No GPU model eval: parser-level change; the issue's raw model text is pinned as a unit test.

## AI assistance disclosure

Prepared with AI assistance (Kimi). The diff and the verification results above were checked during preparation.

Rebased onto current main (54020c3c3e) after the Streaming Parser Engine rewrite landed.

Worth being explicit about what changed around this PR: #45701 moved qwen3 parsing into the engine, but the bug this PR fixes still reproduces on main. The engine's flush converts with partial=False, and the one-shot answer comes from that conversion, so the unclosed trailing parameter is still dropped there.
```
extract_tool_calls('<tool_call><function=get_weather>'
  '<parameter=city>Seattle</parameter>'
  '<parameter=unit>celsius</function></tool_call>')
-> {"city": "Seattle"}            # main: trailing unit dropped
-> {"city": "Seattle", "unit": "celsius"}   # this head
```

(The engine never puts the </function> marker into the accumulated raw body, so the trailing capture runs cleanly to end of buffer. The sibling tail-class PRs for minimax_m2/glm47/deepseek_v4 were covered by the rewrite and closed; qwen3's was not.)

Resolved the merge conflict against current main and restated the fix on the post-#64675 parser.

The conflict was structural: the old inline trailing-parameter capture in the arg converter was removed when #64675 refactored parameter parsing into `_qwen3_parse_params`, where the open trailing parameter was only gathered when `partial` was true. That gate is the bug, so the fix is now to gather the open trailing parameter regardless of `partial`, letting the final conversion keep a value the model left unclosed before ending the call.

Red-green on `tests/parser/engine/test_qwen3.py` (CPU, no GPU): the three `TestUnclosedLastParameter` cases fail against the un-fixed parser and pass with this change; the full file is 89 passed. The PR diff vs main is just the fix and its tests.

files.patch:
@@ -1534,3 +1534,61 @@ def test_mimo_preserves_verbatim_parameter_values(
     )
     assert collect_function_name(results) == "run"
     assert json.loads(collect_tool_arguments(results)) == {"text": value}
+
+
+class TestUnclosedLastParameter:
+    """#57699: the model sometimes closes </function> without </parameter>
+    on the last parameter. Its value must survive the final conversion."""
+
+    def test_nonstreaming_last_parameter_without_close(self, parser, mock_request):
+        text = (
+            "<tool_call>\n"
+            "<function=ThinQ_Connect>\n"
+            "<parameter=body>\n"
+            '{"airConJobMode": "AIR_CLEAN", "windStrength": "HIGH", '
+            '"monitoringEnabled": true}\n'
+            "</function>\n"
+            "</tool_call>"
+        )
+        result = parser.extract_tool_calls(text, mock_request)
+
+        assert result.tools_called is True
+        args = json.loads(result.tool_calls[0].function.arguments)
+        assert args == {
+            "body": '{"airConJobMode": "AIR_CLEAN", "windStrength": "HIGH", '
+            '"monitoringEnabled": true}'
+        }
+
+    def test_nonstreaming_earlier_params_kept_with_unclosed_tail(
+        self, parser, mock_request
+    ):
+        text = (
+            "<tool_call>\n"
+            "<function=get_weather>\n"
+            "<parameter=city>Tokyo</parameter>\n"
+            "<parameter=days>5\n"
+            "</function>\n"
+            "</tool_call>"
+        )
+        result = parser.extract_tool_calls(text, mock_request)
+
+        args = json.loads(result.tool_calls[0].function.arguments)
+        assert args == {"city": "Tokyo", "days": "5"}
+
+    def test_streaming_flush_does_not_truncate_streamed_args(
+        self, parser, mock_request
+    ):
+        # partial conversions already streamed the trailing value; the flush
+        # at TOOL_CALL_END must not emit a shorter "{}" that clips it away.
+        chunks = [
+            "<tool_call>\n",
+            "<function=get_weather>\n",
+            "<parameter=city>Tokyo</parameter>\n",
+            "<parameter=days>5\n",
+            "</function>\n",
+            "</tool_call>",
+        ]
+        results = simulate_tool_streaming(parser, mock_request, chunks)
+
+        args_text = collect_tool_arguments(results)
+        assert json.loads(args_text) == {"city": "Tokyo", "days": "5"}

@@ -110,9 +110,10 @@ def _qwen3_parse_params(
         closed.params = dict(params)
         closed.outside = "".join(outside)
 
-    open_param = None
-    if partial:
-        open_param = _PARTIAL_PARAM_RE.search("".join(outside) + raw_args[pos:])
+    # A model can end the call without closing the last parameter; the trailing
+    # value must survive the final conversion (partial False) too, not just the
+    # streamed partial ones, so capture it regardless of partial.
+    open_param = _PARTIAL_PARAM_RE.search("".join(outside) + raw_args[pos:])
     return params, open_param
